experiment_data.hypothesis: An MLP+average-pooling compressor (no cross-attention, no learnable queries) with matched parameter count (~22M) will underperform the cross-attention VisionTokenCompressor at M=32, demonstrating that cross-attention's ability to selectively attend to informative tokens is critical for effective vision token compression.

spec.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 WANDB_MODE=offline python -u train_smart_compress.py --config configs/mlp_adapter_control.yaml --wandb_run mlp_adapter_control --seed 42 --gpu 0
spec.notes: Control experiment: MLP+avg-pool compressor (no cross-attention) with matched params (~22.14M) vs VisionTokenCompressor M=32. 3x MLP blocks (Linear 960->3840 + GELU + Linear 3840->960 + LN). 128 tokens -> avg pool -> 32 tokens. tmux session: mlp_adapter_control
